messages.subject: Re: Download a saved image
parts:
This should be all you need. The content function is called at download time, so you don't need to worry about keeping it up-to-date.

Also, there's almost never a reason to assign an output from inside an observer. Nor to call renderImage without assigning it to an output slot.

output$downloadReport2<- downloadHandler(
    filename <- function() {
      paste(toupper(gsub("stock_","",input$variable)),'Sentiment', Sys.Date(),'.png',sep='') 

      },
    
    content <- function(file) {
png(file, width = 980, height = 400, units = "px", pointsize = 12,
